system.description: Sun god of mercy, kindness and healing who wants everyone to be decent to one another; hugely popular and rarely banned.
system.summary: Sun god of mercy, kindness and healing who wants everyone to be decent to one another; hugely popular and rarely banned.
commandments: Ease suffering wherever you meet it.
Carry his light into dark places with compassion.
directives: Show mercy to everyone; it is strength that can redeem even souls.
Embrace and preserve peace in a war-torn Wheel.
Study others' ways and reasons so you can understand them.
Giving is the best gift; rejoice in freeing others from strife.
Light is his face; it exposes lies and drives heretics from hiding.

cults.name: The Children of the Sun
cults.summary: A vast, powerless movement of strict pacifists and vegetarians who give away their money and send missionaries far afield.

cults.name: The Solar Skimmers
cults.summary: Wealthy thrill-seekers who fly ships as near to stars as possible and honor Pelor as sun and healer.
